senses.gloss:
Hail,Ⓒinterj.ⒹnamaH, svasti, (with dat.); oft. ex. by ji 1 P; jayatu jayatu devaH ‘h(ail) to Your Majesty’; kuSalaM BUyAt, aBi-vAdaye.
Ⓔs.ⒹSilAvfzwi f., karakAnipAtaH; ‘h(ail)-stone’ karakA varzopalaH, varzaSilA, payo-GanaH, Gana-meGa-kaPaH; ‘h(ail)-storm’ karakAsAraH, SilAvarzaH.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹupalAn vfz 1 P or nipat c., karakAsAraM pat c.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹvaMd 1 A, aBivad 10 A, saMbuD c., AmaMtr 10 A, A-aBi-BAz 1 A, A-hve 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 (fig.) prItyA-mudA-aMgIkf 8 U; aBinaMd 1 P.

Hair,Ⓒs.ⒹkeSaH, kacaH, bAlaH, cikuraH, kuMtalaH; ‘h(air) on the head’ SiroruhaH, mUrDajaH, Sira-sijaH.
Ⓑ
 2 (Of the body gen.) ro(lo)-mana n., tanUruhaH-haM, tanujaH; ‘quantity of h(air)’ kESyaM, kESika.
Ⓑ
 3 keSa(sa)raH; ‘whole collection of h(air)’ keSakalApaH-pakzaH-hastaH-pASaH; ‘h(air) hanging on the forehead’ BramarakAH; ‘lock of h(air)’ kAkapakzaH, SiKaMqakaH; ‘matted h(air)’ jawA, sawA; ‘a braid of h(air)’ kabarI, keSaveSaH; ‘curled h(air)’ alakaH, cUrRa-kuMtalaH; ‘braided h(air)’ veRi-RI f., Da-mmillaH; ‘crest-h(air)’ SiKA, cUqA, keSapASI; ‘clean h(air)’ SIrzaRyaH, SirasyaH, ‘h(air)-broom or brush’ keSamArjanI-SoDanI; ‘h(air)-dressing’ keSaracanA-saMskAraH; ‘even a h(air)s breadth’, reKAmAtramapi; ‘a h(air)-breadth escape’ kaTamapi labDA muktiH.
Ⓝ[Hair]less,Ⓒa.ⒹakeSa, keSahIna, vikeSa.
Ⓝ[Hair]y,Ⓒa.ⒹlomaSa, lomAvfta pracura-bahu-loman, lomamaya (yI f.), lomavat, lomapUrRa, keSava, keSin, keSika.
